label: dataform compile
args: d="$1"; while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/workflow_settings.yaml" ] && [ ! -f "$d/dataform.json" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if [ "$d" = / ]; then echo "dataform: no workflow_settings.yaml or dataform.json found above $1" >&2; exit 1; fi; cmd="$2"; shift 2; echo "\$ dataform $cmd $d $*"; exec dataform "$cmd" "$d" "$@"
